meta.name: Diwali - all F&O stocks: past data, position taking and key details (project 8x8 grid)
meta.disclaimer: No trade / no-trade decision is made in this file. selected_position is simply the scan rule output (best win-rate window); stats are facts, not recommendations. Windows were chosen on the same history they are scored on (in-sample); walk_forward is the out-of-sample view.

conventions.anchor: Laxmi Pujan / Muhurat date T (hand-corrected 2000-2025); the Muhurat session is not a trading day
conventions.offsets: sessions[] ordered T-8..T-1, T+1..T+8 (index 0..15). Entry = close of T-N = sessions[8-N]; exit = close of T+M = sessions[7+M]
conventions.return_formula: LONG % = (adj_close[exit]/adj_close[entry]-1)*100; SHORT = -LONG; grid[N-1][M-1] = LONG % for entry T-N, exit T+M, null = invalid window that year
conventions.scan: PROJECT 8x8 GRID: lead 1..8 x hold 1..8 x LONG/SHORT; needs >= 7 valid years; pick by win rate then avg signed return; windows with >35% daily move, >40 calendar-day span or no session within 7 days of T are invalid
conventions.calendar: market day = >= 30% of listed stocks traded volume; prices: adj_close for returns, raw_close as quoted

event_2026.note: Laxmi Pujan / Muhurat on a Sunday; 2026-11-10 (Balipratipada) added as a market holiday
